name: Erik (wrestler)
profileSummary: Raymond Rowe is an American professional wrestler. As of January 2018, he is signed to WWE, where he performs on the Raw brand and Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) under the ring name Erik. He is in a tag team with Ivar called The War Raiders. He is one-half of the current AAA World Tag Team Champion with Ivar, in their first reign. He is a former two-time World Tag Team Champion with Ivar and are former one-time NXT Tag Team Champion.
